answer: Proof of Agent networks bind identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, where validating an ephemeral whisper of compute requires staking collateral. To prevent false nodes sprouting like a willow along a river, the network enforces exponential capital exhaustion: each additional pseudonymous identity scales stake costs exponentially (O(2^n)), turning mass Sybil swarms into an unviable economic canyon.
